content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: Service= inference-prod | Alert= high-error-rate (500s) | Priority= P1 | Link= https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P123456789
kevin: acked. I'm taking it. pinging runtime oncall.
maria: saw the notify—what team got the page? I only saw infra get pinged.
jordan: same. pagerduty shows routing to 'infra-escalation' policy, not 'runtime-main'. that feels wrong. did someone change routing?
oncall-rota-bot: Note: temporary schedule override applied by @ash yesterday for testing shadow schedule (expires in 2d).
kevin: that explains it. shadow schedule override pulled infra into the chain. @ash, did you mean to leave that enabled?
ash: oops, yeah i ran a quick test for PD rules and forgot to remove the override. my bad.
maria: okay, infra is getting pages but the errors are from model-serving pods. customers hitting model API saw 502/timeout.
ash: i can roll pods if needed. posting current pod list:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference-prod
model-server-0   2/3 CrashLoopBackOff   5   2m
model-server-1   3/3 Running            0   10m
routing-proxy-0 2/2 Running            0   15m
```
kevin: crashloop on model-server-0 -> can we get logs?
ash: tailing logs now:
```
2026-03-14T17:12:02Z ERROR model-serving: failed to allocate KV cache chunk: out of memory
2026-03-14T17:12:03Z ERROR proxy: upstream returned 502 for request id=...
```
maria: looks like memory pressure plus an unlucky pod. traffic redistributed but some requests hit the unhealthy pod and 502d. customer impact limited but measurable.
jordan: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily silence PD alerts for inference-prod to stop noisy fanout 2) reassign PD routing to runtime-main policy 3) restart model-server-0 4) monitor for 30m
kevin: doing step 1 and 2 now.
kevin: (PagerDuty) Silence added for service inference-prod for 60m. Reassigning alert routing to runtime-main policy... done.
oncall-rota-bot: Routing override removed by @maria. Current oncall: runtime-main -> @maria.
maria: restarting model-server-0: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/model-server -n inference-prod --field-selector metadata.name=model-server-0`
ash: restart initiated.
ash: model-server-0 back to Running 3/3. tail of logs shows healthy startup.
jordan: errors dropped back to baseline. Grafana panel: 5xx spike lasted ~4m and is back to normal.
kevin: good. resolving PD alert now and will wait 30m of stability before closing incident.
kevin: (PagerDuty) Alert resolved.
sre-ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-142 for follow-up (owner=maria).
maria: customer impact summary: roughly 0.8% of requests experienced 5-10s latency; two customers reported 502s for ~3 minutes. no data loss.
maria: action items: - remove ad-hoc PD schedule overrides after tests - add CI check to verify PD routing for inference-prod - add guardrail to prevent shadow schedules from matching production services - include observed memory pressure metric in healthchecks
jordan: also suggest a smoke-test after rolling config changes so a misrouted PD doesn't go unnoticed.
kevin: agreed. i'll add post-incident retro and schedule the fix PR. maria will own the postmortem. thanks everyone for quick responses :thumbsup:
maria: i'll file the postmortem and include the PD policy change diff. closing thread once retro is posted.
